intro: Set the table and slow the day. Garnet’s rubber wood top, curved edges, and a handy shelf make weeknight dinners easy and festive spreads calmer, while open clearance keeps cleaning quick. Now.

features.title: Curved edges keep dinners worry-free
features.text: Rounded edges soften bumps and protect little elbows and passing hips, so you can reach, serve, and lean in for conversation without sharp corners interrupting the moment. Enjoy family-friendly edges.

features.title: Bottom shelf tames table clutter
features.text: The built-in shelf holds placemats, trays, or a fruit bowl within easy reach, giving you space on the top to plate, pour, and pass without juggling or crowding the meal. So the surface stays clear.

features.title: Rubber wood strength you can trust
features.text: Made of rubber wood in a warm walnut shade, the table brings reliable stability to daily dining while resisting everyday wear, so it stays welcoming through years of use. Seasoned wood resists insects.

features.title: Angular legs that lift your look
features.text: Refined, angled legs add visual lightness and modern poise, turning everyday meals into a setting that feels styled and intentional without demanding attention. Your dining space feels airy and calm.

features.title: Knockdown design that fits your life
features.text: Delivered knockdown to move through doors and lifts with ease, then assembled into a sturdy centerpiece, so shifting homes or refreshing layouts stays simple and stress-free. Setup stays simple.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
